commit.message:
feat(machine): add the AGIECUT Classic 2S wire EDM template

Register the handbook-backed machine in the desktop and embedded libraries. Preserve the unstated installation limits and require the user to supply a cutting condition.

Co-Authored-By: Codex <noreply@openai.com>

Fixes #2946

test(machine): include the Classic 2S in the catalogue contract

Co-Authored-By: Codex <noreply@openai.com>

Fixes #2946

feat(wire): post a native Agie Classic Cut 2S job

Produce a linked ISO, SBR and SBL bundle from a validated nominal rectangular punch. Use the operator-configured Classic 2S template and its resident QN2 technology. Preserve existing output and reject unsupported machine and geometry settings.

Co-Authored-By: Codex <noreply@openai.com>

Fixes #2945

fix(wire): validate the mounted Agie condition role and diameter

Refuse a condition that a generic wire operation can preview if it does not explicitly select the supported rough wire row for native Agie output.

Co-Authored-By: Codex <noreply@openai.com>

Fixes #2945

feat(wire): post convex Agie punches with checked corner clearance

Keep the complete nominal polygon and bound the swept wire for both round and mitered joins. Check perpendicular entry room along an oblique face. Add an original pentagonal punch example.

Co-Authored-By: Codex <noreply@openai.com>

Fixes #2953

fix(wire): bound oblique Agie entry rounding on the ISO grid

Check both sides of the emitted seam against the drilled hole, separation allowance, retained punch and stock envelope. Preserve the nominal polygon and fixed start-hole position.

Co-Authored-By: Codex <noreply@openai.com>

Refs #2953

feat(post): support measured Agie QN2 stock heights

Use the measured maximum wire-centre offset for each supported plate thickness. Check the swept wire and acute corner miters before publishing the native bundle.

Co-Authored-By: Codex <noreply@openai.com>

Fixes #2954

feat(post): support checked reentrant Agie punch contours

Prove that the cap unions and each finite wall form one vertical extrusion. Check rough compensation at inside corners and clearance between unrelated faces. Keep the nominal polygon and exterior entry in the native job.

Co-Authored-By: Codex <noreply@openai.com>

Fixes #2956

feat(post): export a selected Agie through die opening

Match the selected edge chains to the complete vertical through-opening. Check the interior threading lead, rough joins and nominal wall clearance before emitting the closed die cycle.

Co-Authored-By: Codex <noreply@openai.com>

Fixes #2957

feat(post): emit Agie straight cutoffs with separate air endpoints

Check the retained wall, kerf side, air approaches and centered XY travel. Require the operator to clamp both pieces through all QN2 passes. Keep closed work on its existing nominal cycle.

Co-Authored-By: Codex <noreply@openai.com>

Fixes #2962

feat(post): group two captured Agie punches on one piece

Validate each retained source, pierced lead and swept cut against its partner. Bind the two geometry resources and work points in one atomic native controller job.

Co-Authored-By: Codex <noreply@openai.com>

Fixes #2961

test(post): exercise both native Agie cutoff compensation sides

Both source selections now travel in positive X. Pin the independent left and right native work types and the two start points on each job.

Co-Authored-By: Codex <noreply@openai.com>

Fixes #2962
Merge branch 'issue/2962-agie-straight-cutoff' into issue/2961-agie-multiple-works

feat(wire): post a placed DXF racetrack with native Agie arcs

Prove the tangent capsule from the source lines and semicircles. Check its through-stock punch with a circumscribed preview, track source and placement changes, and write the nominal circular caps with the resident wire compensation.

Co-Authored-By: Codex <noreply@openai.com>

Refs #2022

feat(post): select the Agie Ra 0.35 quality for a 20 mm punch

Validate the explicitly selected condition at its measured stock height. Preserve the original Ra 0.30 output and keep compensation with the control.

Co-Authored-By: Codex <noreply@openai.com>

Fixes #2966

feat(wire): post a source DXF circle with native arc separation

Check the whole circular punch and its radial entry. Export the two nominal semicircles and leave the qualified 1 mm circular separation and wire offsets to the controller.

Co-Authored-By: Codex <noreply@openai.com>

Refs #2022

feat(post): group two through openings on one Agie die plate

Match both selected rims to the complete retained plate and check their independent cut envelopes before writing the native job.

Co-Authored-By: Codex <noreply@openai.com>

Fixes #2977

feat(wire): qualify cardinal DXF circle entries and bounded radii

Check the exact radial line through the threading hole. Use the original center and diameter at 6 to 15 mm radius for the qualified 1 mm circular separation.

Co-Authored-By: Codex <noreply@openai.com>

Refs #2022

Merge branch 'issue/2022-agie-placed-dxf' into issue/2966-agie-fine-quality

Qualify separate modeled punches on one stock. Check each pair of complete wire envelopes and use independent controller work and geometry names.

feat(post): qualify up to nine independent Agie punches

Use the measured nine-resource limit and cover the full grid, the tenth-work refusal and source ownership.
